sys_pd_activity.description:
Update the Data Source access to enable creating data sources for the new connection by verifying that you have edit permissions on the Data Source [sys_data_source] table.
To verify and update permissions on the Data Source[sys_data_source] table:

  1. Select the Global application scope from the application picker.
  2. In the Application Access related list, select the Can create, Can update, and Can delete check boxes, and then select Update.
  3. Select the application scope associated with the connector from the application picker.
sys_pd_activity.label: Update data source access
sys_pd_activity.name: sgc_update_data_source_acce_

sys_pd_activity.name: sgc_create_new_connection_ad

sys_pd_activity.description:
Clear the cache of the tables Data Source [sys_data_source] and Tables [sys_db_object].

To clear the cache:

  1. In the Run script text box of the background script page, enter the following script:

    GlideTableManager.invalidateTable('sys_data_source'); 
GlideCacheManager.flushTable('sys_data_source');
GlideTableManager.invalidateTable('sys_db_object'); 
GlideCacheManager.flushTable('sys_db_object');
  2. Select Run Script to run the background script in the global scope.
    The script may take several minutes to execute.
  3. After the script is executed successfully, select the application scope associated with the connector from the application picker.
sys_pd_activity.label: Clear cache
sys_pd_activity.name: sgc_clear_cache_ad
